spot.html_text: Several recent efforts at cancer classification use network, “deep learning” methods or AI to mine data to identify patterns of association or clusters of common features within and across different cancer types. These methods have been used to address the so-called “curse of dimensionality” problem: i.e., sort through enormous amounts of genomic data, and speed development of tools for both diagnosis and treatment.
